subproblems.title: A unit orientation of a subspace has operator norm at most 1
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P (Euclid P), and let ξ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P n, i.e. a continuous linear functional on the normed space Covector (Euclid P) n of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P (operator norms throughout). If ξ is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q: there is an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P spanning Q such that ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α), then ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 1(c) of the parent proof of representation independence of θH^n⌞M (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(3)): for an orthonormal family τ and any n-covector α, |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖; hence every unit orientation of an n-plane has norm at most 1. Norms: Covector (Euclid P) n = continuous alternating n-linear forms with the operator norm, MultiVector P n = its continuous dual with the operator norm.

1. By the hypothesis IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q choose an orthonormal family τ = (τ_1,…,τ_n) in ℝ^P (spanning Q; the spanning property is not used below) such that either ξ(α) = α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ_1,…,τ_n) for every n-covector α.
2. Fix an n-covector α. Since α is a continuous multilinear map, |α(τ_1,…,τ_n)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏_{i=1}^n ‖τ_i‖ (operator-norm bound, Mathlib ContinuousAlternatingMap.le_opNorm). Orthonormality gives ‖τ_i‖ = 1 for every i, so the product is 1 (for n = 0 it is the empty product 1). Hence |α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖.
3. In either sign case of step 1, |ξ(α)| = |±α(τ)| = |α(τ)| ≤ 1·‖α‖.
4. Step 3 holds for every n-covector α and 1 ≥ 0, so by the defining property of the operator norm of the continuous linear functional ξ (Mathlib ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound) we obtain ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1. ∎

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition against GMT.Ch07.Submission, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c; place inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
open scoped ContDiff Pointwise in
theorem unit_orientation_norm_le_one : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 := by
  rintro P n Q ξ ⟨τ, hτ, -, hξ⟩
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun α => ?_
  have hbound : ‖α τ‖ ≤ ‖α‖ := by
    have := α.le_opNorm τ
    simpa [hτ.1] using this
  rcases hξ with h | h
  · rw [h, one_mul]; exact hbound
  · rw [h, norm_neg, one_mul]; exact hbound
proof_key_steps: Unpack IsUnitOrientationOf: ξ(α) = ±α(τ) for an orthonormal family τ.
|α(τ)| ≤ ‖α‖·∏‖τ_i‖ = ‖α‖ by the multilinear operator-norm bound and ‖τ_i‖ = 1.
Hence |ξ(α)| ≤ 1·‖α‖ for all α, so ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 by the operator-norm bound (opNorm_le_bound).

subproblems.title: Two unit orientations of the same plane both take absolute value 1 on a common covector
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and let ξ_1, ξ_2 ∈ MultiVector P n both be unit orientations of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ξ_k Q for k = 1, 2: there are orthonormal families τ, τ' spanning Q and signs with ξ_1(α) = ±α(τ) and ξ_2(α) = ±α(τ') for every n-covector α). Then there is an n-covector α on ℝ^P (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n) with |ξ_1(α)| = 1 and |ξ_2(α)| = 1. (With ξ_1 = ξ_2 this shows that a unit orientation is non-zero.)
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₁ Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₂ Q → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ₁ α| = 1 ∧ |ξ₂ α| = 1
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1(b) and 1(d) of the parent proof of representation independence of θH^n⌞M (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(3)): the frame-determinant covector δ_τ(w) = det(⟨τ_i, w_j⟩)_{i,j} satisfies δ_τ(τ) = 1 and, for any orthonormal τ' with the same span, δ_τ(τ') = det O ∈ {−1, +1} with O = (⟨τ_i, τ'_j⟩); hence a unit orientation built on τ or on τ' takes the value ±1 at δ_τ.

1. Unpack the hypotheses: there are orthonormal families τ, τ' : Fin n → ℝ^P with span(τ) = Q = span(τ') and signs ε_1, ε_2 ∈ {1, −1} such that ξ_1(α) = ε_1·α(τ) and ξ_2(α) = ε_2·α(τ') for every n-covector α.
2. (The frame-determinant covector.) For w = (w_1,…,w_n) ∈ (ℝ^P)^n put δ(w) := det(⟨τ_i, w_j⟩)_{i,j=1}^n. It is n-linear (the determinant is linear in each column, and the j-th column (⟨τ_i, w_j⟩)_i depends linearly on w_j alone) and alternating (if w_j = w_k for some j ≠ k the matrix has two equal columns, so δ(w) = 0). It is continuous: by the Leibniz formula and Cauchy–Schwarz with ‖τ_i‖ = 1, |δ(w)| ≤ Σ_σ ∏_j |⟨τ_{σ(j)}, w_j⟩| ≤ n!·∏_j ‖w_j‖, and a multilinear map satisfying such a bound is continuous. Hence δ is an n-covector on ℝ^P. (For n = 0, δ is the constant 1, the determinant of the empty matrix.)
3. δ(τ) = det(⟨τ_i, τ_j⟩) = det(I_n) = 1, by orthonormality of τ.
4. Put O_{ij} := ⟨τ_i, τ'_j⟩, so δ(τ') = det O. Each τ'_j lies in Q = span(τ); writing τ'_j = Σ_i c_i τ_i and pairing with τ_k gives c_k = ⟨τ_k, τ'_j⟩ = O_{kj}, i.e. τ'_j = Σ_i O_{ij} τ_i. Therefore ⟨τ'_j, τ'_k⟩ = Σ_i O_{ij} O_{ik} = (OᵀO)_{jk}. Since τ' is orthonormal, OᵀO = I_n, so (det O)² = det(Oᵀ)·det(O) = det(OᵀO) = 1 and det O ∈ {1, −1}.
5. Take α := δ. Then |ξ_1(δ)| = |ε_1|·|δ(τ)| = 1 by step 3 and |ξ_2(δ)| = |ε_2|·|det O| = 1 by step 4. ∎

Lean route used by the reference implementation (same covector, different bookkeeping): build orthonormal bases b, b' of the subspace Q from τ, τ' (OrthonormalBasis.mk; orthonormality transported by Q.subtypeₗᵢ.orthonormal_comp_iff, spanning by Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun); δ := b.toBasis.det composed with the orthogonal projection π_Q = Q.orthogonalProjectionOnto (the b-coordinates of π_Q w_j are ⟨τ_i, w_j⟩, so this is the δ of step 2). Mathlib at this pin has no continuity theorem for multilinear maps on finite-dimensional spaces, so δ is made continuous with AlternatingMap.mkContinuous and the bound |δ(w)| = |volumeForm(π_Q w)| ≤ ∏‖π_Q w_i‖ ≤ ∏‖w_i‖ (Orientation.volumeForm_robust', Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_le, Submodule.norm_orthogonalProjectionOnto_apply_le, with Fact (finrank ℝ Q = n) and the orientation of b). Steps 3–4 become |δ(τ)| = |det_b b| = 1 and |δ(τ')| = |det_b b'| = 1 (Orientation.abs_volumeForm_apply_of_orthonormal; equivalently OrthonormalBasis.det_to_matrix_orthonormalBasis_real). SimonGMT's wedgeCovectors_apply_det (Chapter06/FormsDuality.lean) is not imported by GMT.Ch07.Submission.

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition against GMT.Ch07.Submission, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c; place inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
open scoped ContDiff Pointwise in
theorem unit_orientations_common_unit_covector : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : MultiVector P n), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₁ Q → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ₂ Q → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ₁ α| = 1 ∧ |ξ₂ α| = 1 := by
  rintro P n Q ξ₁ ξ₂ ⟨τ, hτ, hspan, hξ₁⟩ ⟨τ', hτ', hspan', hξ₂⟩
  -- an orthonormal frame spanning `Q` is an orthonormal basis of `Q`
  have frame : ∀ σ : Fin n → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ σ → Submodule.span ℝ (range σ) = Q →
      ∃ c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ Q, ∀ i, (c i : Euclid P) = σ i := by
    intro σ hσ hσspan
    have hmem : ∀ i, σ i ∈ Q := fun i => hσspan ▸ Submodule.subset_span (mem_range_self i)
    let w : Fin n → Q := fun i => ⟨σ i, hmem i⟩
    have hw : Orthonormal ℝ w := by
      rw [← Q.subtypeₗᵢ.orthonormal_comp_iff (v := w)]
      exact hσ
    have hwspan : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span ℝ (range w) := by
      rintro ⟨y, hy⟩ -
      rw [← hσspan, Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hy
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hy
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
      exact ⟨c, Subtype.ext (by simpa [w] using hc)⟩
    exact ⟨OrthonormalBasis.mk hw hwspan, fun i => by simp [w]⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := frame τ hτ hspan
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := frame τ' hτ' hspan'
  have : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n) := ⟨by simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b.toBasis⟩
  let o : Orientation ℝ Q (Fin n) := b.toBasis.orientation
  let π : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Q := Q.orthogonalProjectionOnto
  -- the frame determinant `δ(w) = det_b (π_Q w)`
  let A : Euclid P [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := b.toBasis.det.compLinearMap π.toLinearMap
  have hA : ∀ w, ‖A w‖ ≤ 1 * ∏ i, ‖w i‖ := by
    intro w
    have h1 : |A w| = |o.volumeForm (fun i => π (w i))| :=
      (o.volumeForm_robust' b (fun i => π (w i))).symm
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, h1, one_mul]
    refine (o.abs_volumeForm_apply_le _).trans ?_
    gcongr with i
    exact Q.norm_orthogonalProjectionOnto_apply_le (w i)
  let δ : Covector (Euclid P) n := A.mkContinuous 1 hA
  have hπ : ∀ (c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ Q) (i : Fin n), π (c i : Euclid P) = c i := fun c i =>
    Q.orthogonalProjectionOnto_mem_subspace_eq_self (c i)
  have hδ : ∀ (c : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n) ℝ Q) (σ : Fin n → Euclid P),
      (∀ i, (c i : Euclid P) = σ i) → |δ σ| = 1 := by
    intro c σ hc
    have h2 : δ σ = b.toBasis.det (fun i => π (σ i)) := rfl
    have h3 : (fun i => π (σ i)) = c := by
      funext i; rw [← hc i, hπ]
    rw [h2, h3, ← o.volumeForm_robust' b]
    exact o.abs_volumeForm_apply_of_orthonormal c
  refine ⟨δ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hξ₁ with h | h
    · rw [h]; exact hδ b τ hb
    · rw [h, abs_neg]; exact hδ b τ hb
  · rcases hξ₂ with h | h
    · rw [h]; exact hδ b' τ' hb'
    · rw [h, abs_neg]; exact hδ b' τ' hb'
proof_key_steps: Unpack: ξ_1(α) = ε_1α(τ), ξ_2(α) = ε_2α(τ') with τ, τ' orthonormal frames of Q and ε_k = ±1.
The frame determinant δ(w) = det(⟨τ_i, w_j⟩) is a continuous alternating n-form with δ(τ) = 1.
O = (⟨τ_i, τ'_j⟩) satisfies OᵀO = I because τ'_j = Σ_i O_{ij}τ_i, so δ(τ') = det O = ±1.

subproblems.title: Approximate tangent planes are unchanged by H^n-null modifications of the set
subproblems.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and A, B ⊆ ℝ^P with H^n(A ∖ B) = 0 and H^n(B ∖ A) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n]. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P: Q is an approximate tangent space of A at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q: finrank Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), with η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x)) if and only if Q is an approximate tangent space of B at x.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (A \ B) = 0 → μHE[n] (B \ A) = 0 → (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 4 of the parent proof of representation independence of θH^n⌞M (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(3)): blow-ups of H^n-a.e. equal sets coincide up to H^n-null sets, so the limits in Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (approximate tangent space) agree.

Notation: H^n = μHE[n]; for r ∈ ℝ, b_r := blowUpMap x r, b_r(y) = r^{-1}(y − x) (Simon's η_{x,r}).
1. (Definition.) HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q means: finrank Q = n and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), φ_M^f(r) := ∫_{b_r(M)} f dH^n converges to ∫_Q f dH^n as r → 0 with r > 0 (along the filter 𝓝[>] 0).
2. (Null sets stay null under b_r, r ≠ 0.) Let S ⊆ ℝ^P with H^n(S) = 0. Then b_r(S) = r^{-1}·(S − x), where S − x is the image of S under the isometry y ↦ y − x. Isometries preserve H^n (Mathlib Isometry.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image), so H^n(S − x) = 0; and H^n(c·S') = |c|^n·H^n(S') for c ≠ 0 (Mathlib Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀). Hence H^n(b_r(S)) = 0.
3. (The blow-ups agree up to null sets.) For any map b, b(A) ∖ b(B) ⊆ b(A ∖ B): if y = b(a) with a ∈ A and y ∉ b(B), then a ∉ B (Mathlib Set.subset_image_sdiff). Likewise b(B) ∖ b(A) ⊆ b(B ∖ A). By the hypotheses H^n(A ∖ B) = 0 = H^n(B ∖ A) and step 2, for every r ≠ 0 both differences b_r(A) ∖ b_r(B) and b_r(B) ∖ b_r(A) are H^n-null, i.e. b_r(A) and b_r(B) coincide up to an H^n-null set (Mathlib ae_eq_set). Consequently H^n⌞b_r(A) = H^n⌞b_r(B), and φ_A^f(r) = φ_B^f(r) for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) and every r ≠ 0 (Mathlib setIntegral_congr_set). No integrability is needed: the two set integrals are integrals against the same restricted measure.
4. (The limits agree.) Fix f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P). The set (0, ∞) belongs to 𝓝[>] 0 (self_mem_nhdsWithin) and φ_A^f = φ_B^f on it by step 3, so φ_A^f converges to L along 𝓝[>] 0 if and only if φ_B^f does (Filter.Tendsto.congr').
5. The dimension clause finrank Q = n is literally the same on both sides. Combining it with step 4 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) gives HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q, for every x and every Q. ∎

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition against GMT.Ch07.Submission, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c; place inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
open scoped ContDiff Pointwise in
theorem hasApproximateTangentSpaceAt_iff_of_null_sdiff : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (A \ B) = 0 → μHE[n] (B \ A) = 0 → (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q) := by
  intro P n A B x Q hAB hBA
  have himg_null : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] S = 0 →
      μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S) = 0 := by
    intro r hr S hS
    have himg : Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S =
        r⁻¹ • ((fun y => y - x) '' S) := by
      rw [← Set.image_smul, Set.image_image]
      rfl
    have hiso : Isometry (fun y : Euclid P => y - x) := (IsometryEquiv.subRight x).isometry
    rw [himg, Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀ n (inv_ne_zero hr),
      hiso.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image, hS, smul_zero]
  have hint : ∀ r : ℝ, r ≠ 0 → ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ,
      ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' A, f y ∂μHE[n] =
        ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B, f y ∂μHE[n] := by
    intro r hr f
    apply setIntegral_congr_set
    refine ae_eq_set.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact measure_mono_null (Set.subset_image_sdiff _ _ _) (himg_null r hr _ hAB)
    · exact measure_mono_null (Set.subset_image_sdiff _ _ _) (himg_null r hr _ hBA)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hdim, hlim⟩
    refine ⟨hdim, fun f => (hlim f).congr' ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    exact hint r (ne_of_gt hr) f
  · rintro ⟨hdim, hlim⟩
    refine ⟨hdim, fun f => (hlim f).congr' ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
    exact (hint r (ne_of_gt hr) f).symm
proof_key_steps: For r ≠ 0, η_{x,r} is a translation followed by a dilation, so it maps H^n-null sets to H^n-null sets.
η(A) ∖ η(B) ⊆ η(A ∖ B) and η(B) ∖ η(A) ⊆ η(B ∖ A), so the blow-ups of A and B agree up to H^n-null sets and their integrals coincide for every r > 0.
Functions that agree on (0, ∞) have the same limits along 𝓝[>] 0, and the dimension clause is shared, so the two predicates are equivalent.

subproblems.title: Two representations of one current have a.e. equal vector densities 1_M θ ξ
subproblems.statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let R_1 = (M_1, θ_1, ξ_1) and R_2 = (M_2, θ_2, ξ_2) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n) that both represent T (R_1.Represents T and R_2.Represents T). Then for H^n⌞(M_1 ∪ M_2)-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P (H^n = μHE[n]) the n-vectors 1_{M_1}(x)θ_1(x)ξ_1(x) and 1_{M_2}(x)θ_2(x)ξ_2(x) in MultiVector P n are equal.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier)), R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x = R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 2 of the parent proof of representation independence of θH^n⌞M (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(3)), with its preliminaries 1(a), 1(c), 1(d): test T on the forms ω = gα for all n-covectors α and apply the Banach-valued fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations on the open set U (Mathlib IsOpen.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero, which needs no local finiteness of the measure).

Notation. M_k = R_k.carrier (Borel, M_k ⊆ U), θ_k = R_k.mult (measurable, ℕ-valued, θ_k ≥ 1 on M_k), ξ_k = R_k.orient (k = 1, 2); H = μHE[n]; ν := H⌞(M_1 ∪ M_2), so ν ≤ H; Λ := MultiVector P n with the operator norm (a real Banach space); F_k(x) := 1_{M_k}(x)·θ_k(x)·ξ_k(x) ∈ Λ; Θ_k(x) := 1_{M_k}(x)·θ_k(x) ∈ [0, ∞); f := F_1 − F_2. The claim is F_1(x) = F_2(x) for ν-a.e. x.
1. (Measurability.) θ_k is measurable and ξ_k is a.e.-strongly measurable for H⌞M_k (R_k.aestronglyMeasurable_orient), so x ↦ θ_k(x)ξ_k(x) is a.e.-strongly measurable for H⌞M_k; as M_k is measurable, its indicator F_k is a.e.-strongly measurable for H (Mathlib aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff), hence for ν ≤ H and every restriction of ν. Consequently f, g·f (g continuous) and x ↦ g(x)·F_k(x)(α) (evaluation at a covector α is continuous on Λ) are a.e.-strongly measurable for ν.
2. (Pointwise bound; parent 1(c), 1(d).) By R_k.orients, for H-a.e. x ∈ M_k there is a subspace Q with IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ_k(x)) Q, hence ‖ξ_k(x)‖ ≤ 1 by the sibling lemma unit_orientation_norm_le_one. So for H-a.e. x: if x ∈ M_k then ‖F_k(x)‖ ≤ θ_k(x)·‖ξ_k(x)‖ ≤ θ_k(x) = Θ_k(x) (‖c·L‖ ≤ |c|·‖L‖); if x ∉ M_k then F_k(x) = 0 = Θ_k(x). Thus ‖F_k‖ ≤ Θ_k H-a.e., hence ν-a.e.
3. (Θ_k is integrable on compact subsets of U; parent 1(a).) For compact K ⊆ U, ∫_K Θ_k dH = ∫_{M_k ∩ K} θ_k dH < ∞ by R_k.locallyIntegrable_mult. So Θ_k is H-integrable on K, and ν-integrable on K because ν ≤ H.
4. (f is locally integrable on U with respect to ν.) Let x ∈ U and choose r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U. Then K := closedBall(x, r/2) is a compact neighbourhood of x contained in U. On K, f is ν-a.e.-strongly measurable (step 1) and ‖f‖ ≤ ‖F_1‖ + ‖F_2‖ ≤ Θ_1 + Θ_2 ν-a.e. (step 2), where Θ_1 + Θ_2 is ν-integrable on K (step 3); hence f is ν-integrable on K. Since K ∈ 𝓝[U] x, f is locally integrable on U with respect to ν.
5. (Vanishing moments.) Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U, and let C ≥ 0 with |g| ≤ C everywhere (g is continuous with compact support).
 (a) For every n-covector α, ω_α(x) := g(x)·α is a test form in U: it is C^∞ (a smooth scalar function times a constant covector), it has compact support (its support is contained in the support of g), and tsupport ω_α ⊆ tsupport g ⊆ U. So ω_α ∈ TestFormOn U n, and by R_k.Represents T, T(ω_α) = R_k.action(ω_α) = ∫_{M_k} θ_k(x)·ξ_k(x)(g(x)α) dH(x) for k = 1, 2.
 (b) For every α and k the real function h_k(x) := g(x)·F_k(x)(α) is ν-integrable: it is a.e.-strongly measurable (step 1), vanishes off tsupport g, and |h_k(x)| ≤ |g(x)|·‖F_k(x)‖·‖α‖ ≤ C‖α‖·1_{tsupport g}(x)·Θ_k(x) ν-a.e. (step 2), the bound being ν-integrable by step 3 with K = tsupport g (compact, ⊆ U).
 (c) ∫ h_k dν = T(ω_α): by linearity of ξ_k(x), h_k(x) = 1_{M_k}(x)·θ_k(x)·ξ_k(x)(g(x)α); the integral of the indicator of the measurable set M_k equals the integral over M_k (Mathlib integral_indicator), and ν⌞M_k = H⌞(M_k ∩ (M_1 ∪ M_2)) = H⌞M_k; hence ∫ h_k dν = ∫_{M_k} θ_k ξ_k(gα) dH = R_k.action(ω_α) = T(ω_α) by (a).
 (d) The Λ-valued function g·f is ν-integrable: it is a.e.-strongly measurable (step 1) and ‖g(x)f(x)‖ ≤ C·1_{tsupport g}(x)·(Θ_1(x) + Θ_2(x)) ν-a.e. Let I := ∫ g·f dν ∈ Λ. Evaluation at α commutes with the Bochner integral (Mathlib ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply), and (g(x)f(x))(α) = h_1(x) − h_2(x); by (b) and (c), I(α) = ∫ h_1 dν − ∫ h_2 dν = T(ω_α) − T(ω_α) = 0. As α is arbitrary, I = 0.
6. (Fundamental lemma.) ℝ^P is a finite-dimensional real normed space with its Borel σ-algebra, Λ is a real Banach space, U is open, f is locally integrable on U with respect to ν (step 4), and ∫ g·f dν = 0 for every C^∞ function g with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U (step 5). By Mathlib IsOpen.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero, for ν-a.e. x, x ∈ U implies f(x) = 0.
7. (Conclusion.) ν = H⌞(M_1 ∪ M_2) is carried by the measurable set M_1 ∪ M_2 ⊆ U (Mathlib ae_restrict_mem; R_k.carrier_subset), so ν-a.e. x lies in U and therefore f(x) = 0, i.e. 1_{M_1}(x)θ_1(x)ξ_1(x) = 1_{M_2}(x)θ_2(x)ξ_2(x) for ν-a.e. x. ∎

Lean implementation notes (all verified by the reference implementation below). At this Mathlib pin, instance search does NOT synthesize ContinuousENorm, NormSMulClass ℝ or TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace for MultiVector P n = Covector (Euclid P) n →L[ℝ] ℝ: the strong topology of a CLM space over a ContinuousAlternatingMap domain is not reducibly the norm topology (the two topologies are equal by rfl). Hence: (i) never state Integrable / LocallyIntegrableOn for Λ-valued functions as fresh terms; obtain those goals from `hU.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero (F := MultiVector P n) (μ := ν) (f := fun x => F R₁ x - F R₂ x) ?hloc ?hmom` and from `rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply ?hint α]`, and close them with Integrable.mono' (real dominating functions) and AEStronglyMeasurable terms built from the IMRep fields (accepted by exact up to defeq); (ii) prove LocallyIntegrableOn directly from its definition with closed balls (locallyIntegrableOn_iff needs the missing PseudoMetrizableSpace instance); (iii) use ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le instead of norm_smul (NormSMulClass is missing); norm_sub_le works (the explicit (E := MultiVector P n) in the reference code is optional). The real-valued integrals of steps 5(b),(c) have no instance problems.

Lean reference implementation (kernel-checked during this decomposition against GMT.Ch07.Submission, Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c; place inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` / `namespace Submission` with the contract's opens; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound):
open scoped ContDiff Pointwise in
theorem imrep_weighted_orient_indicator_ae_eq : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R₁.Represents T → R₂.Represents T → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier)), R₁.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₁.mult y : ℝ) • R₁.orient y) x = R₂.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R₂.mult y : ℝ) • R₂.orient y) x := by
  intro P n U T R₁ R₂ hU h₁ h₂
  set ν := μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier) with hν
  have hνle : ν ≤ μHE[n] := Measure.restrict_le_self
  let F : IMRep U n → Euclid P → MultiVector P n := fun R =>
    R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) • R.orient y)
  let θ : IMRep U n → Euclid P → ℝ := fun R => R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ))
  have hFmeas : ∀ R : IMRep U n, AEStronglyMeasurable (F R) μHE[n] := by
    intro R
    refine (aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff R.measurableSet_carrier).2 ?_
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ)) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) :=
      (measurable_from_nat.comp R.measurable_mult).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact hm.smul R.aestronglyMeasurable_orient
  have hθnn : ∀ R : IMRep U n, ∀ x, 0 ≤ θ R x := fun R x => by
    simp only [θ]; exact indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _) x
  -- pointwise bound ‖F R‖ ≤ θ R, a.e.
  have hFbound : ∀ R : IMRep U n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], ‖F R x‖ ≤ θ R x := by
    intro R
    have hor := R.orients
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' R.measurableSet_carrier] at hor
    filter_upwards [hor] with x hx
    by_cases hmem : x ∈ R.carrier
    · obtain ⟨Q, -, hQ⟩ := hx hmem
      have h1 := unit_orientation_norm_le_one P n Q _ hQ
      simp only [F, θ, indicator_of_mem hmem]
      calc ‖(R.mult x : ℝ) • R.orient x‖ ≤ ‖(R.mult x : ℝ)‖ * ‖R.orient x‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le _ _
        _ ≤ (R.mult x : ℝ) * 1 := by rw [Real.norm_natCast]; gcongr
        _ = R.mult x := mul_one _
    · simp only [F, θ, indicator_of_notMem hmem]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_zero.le
  -- θ R is integrable on compact subsets of U
  have hθint : ∀ R : IMRep U n, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      IntegrableOn (θ R) K μHE[n] := by
    intro R K hK hKU
    refine ⟨((measurable_from_nat.comp R.measurable_mult).indicator
      R.measurableSet_carrier).aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
    have hfin := R.locallyIntegrable_mult K hK hKU
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (Eventually.of_forall (hθnn R))]
    have : ∀ x, ENNReal.ofReal (θ R x) = R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hmem : x ∈ R.carrier
      · simp [θ, indicator_of_mem hmem]
      · simp [θ, indicator_of_notMem hmem]
    simp_rw [this]
    rw [lintegral_indicator R.measurableSet_carrier, Measure.restrict_restrict R.measurableSet_carrier]
    exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hfin
  have key := hU.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero (F := MultiVector P n) (μ := ν)
    (f := fun x => F R₁ x - F R₂ x) ?hloc ?hmom
  · filter_upwards [key, ae_restrict_mem (R₁.measurableSet_carrier.union R₂.measurableSet_carrier)]
      with x hx hmem
    have hxU : x ∈ U := hmem.elim (fun h => R₁.carrier_subset h) (fun h => R₂.carrier_subset h)
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hx hxU)
  case hloc =>
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hx
    have hK : IsCompact (closedBall x (r / 2)) := isCompact_closedBall x (r / 2)
    have hKU : closedBall x (r / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr)).trans hball
    refine ⟨closedBall x (r / 2), mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds (closedBall_mem_nhds x (half_pos hr)), ?_⟩
    refine Integrable.mono' (g := fun y => θ R₁ y + θ R₂ y) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hθint R₁ _ hK hKU).add (hθint R₂ _ hK hKU)).mono_measure hνle
    · exact (((hFmeas R₁).sub (hFmeas R₂)).mono_measure hνle).restrict
    · have h1 := (hFbound R₁)
      have h2 := (hFbound R₂)
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae (hνle.absolutelyContinuous h1),
        ae_restrict_of_ae (hνle.absolutelyContinuous h2)] with y hy1 hy2
      calc ‖F R₁ y - F R₂ y‖ ≤ ‖F R₁ y‖ + ‖F R₂ y‖ := by
            exact norm_sub_le (E := MultiVector P n) (F R₁ y) (F R₂ y)
        _ ≤ θ R₁ y + θ R₂ y := add_le_add hy1 hy2
  case hmom =>
    intro g hg hgc hgU
    have hK : IsCompact (tsupport g) := hgc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hg.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hgc
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hC 0)
    -- the test form `ω = g α`
    have hgα : ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n,
        (fun x => g x • α) ∈ testFormOnSubmodule (E := Euclid P) U n := by
      intro α
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact hg.smul contDiff_const
      · exact hgc.smul_right
      · exact (tsupport_smul_subset_left g (fun _ => α)).trans hgU
    -- `θ R` restricted to `tsupport g` is integrable
    have hθK : ∀ R : IMRep U n, Integrable ((tsupport g).indicator (θ R)) ν := fun R =>
      ((hθint R _ hK hgU).integrable_indicator (isClosed_tsupport g).measurableSet).mono_measure hνle
    -- the scalar identity `∫ g F_R(α) dν = T(gα)`
    have hscal : ∀ R : IMRep U n, R.Represents T → R.carrier ⊆ R₁.carrier ∪ R₂.carrier →
        ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n,
          ∫ x, g x * F R x α ∂ν = T ⟨fun x => g x • α, hgα α⟩ := by
      intro R hR hsub α
      rw [hR ⟨fun x => g x • α, hgα α⟩]
      have hpt : ∀ x, g x * F R x α =
          R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ) * R.orient y (g y • α)) x := by
        intro x
        by_cases hmem : x ∈ R.carrier
        · simp only [F, indicator_of_mem hmem, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
            map_smul]
          ring
        · simp [F, indicator_of_notMem hmem]
      simp_rw [hpt]
      rw [integral_indicator R.measurableSet_carrier, hν,
        Measure.restrict_restrict R.measurableSet_carrier, inter_eq_left.2 hsub]
      rfl
    -- integrability of the scalar integrands
    have hscalint : ∀ R : IMRep U n, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n,
        Integrable (fun x => g x * F R x α) ν := by
      intro R α
      refine Integrable.mono' ((hθK R).const_mul (C * ‖α‖)) ?_ ?_
      · have hev : Continuous fun L : MultiVector P n => L α :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ α).continuous
        exact (hg.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
          (hev.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hFmeas R))).mono_measure hνle
      · filter_upwards [hνle.absolutelyContinuous (hFbound R)] with x hx
        by_cases hx' : x ∈ tsupport g
        · rw [indicator_of_mem hx', norm_mul]
          have h1 : ‖F R x α‖ ≤ ‖F R x‖ * ‖α‖ := (F R x).le_opNorm α
          calc ‖g x‖ * ‖F R x α‖ ≤ C * (θ R x * ‖α‖) := by
                gcongr
                · exact hC x
                · exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (norm_nonneg _))
            _ = C * ‖α‖ * θ R x := by ring
        · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx', zero_mul, norm_zero, indicator_of_notMem hx',
            mul_zero]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun α => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply ?hint α]
    case hint =>
      refine Integrable.mono' ((hθK R₁).add (hθK R₂) |>.const_mul C) ?_ ?_
      · exact ((hg.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable.smul ((hFmeas R₁).sub (hFmeas R₂))).mono_measure
          hνle)
      · filter_upwards [hνle.absolutelyContinuous (hFbound R₁),
          hνle.absolutelyContinuous (hFbound R₂)] with x hx1 hx2
        by_cases hx' : x ∈ tsupport g
        · rw [Pi.add_apply, indicator_of_mem hx', indicator_of_mem hx']
          calc ‖g x • (F R₁ x - F R₂ x)‖ ≤ ‖g x‖ * ‖F R₁ x - F R₂ x‖ :=
                ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le _ _
            _ ≤ C * (θ R₁ x + θ R₂ x) := by
                gcongr
                · exact hC x
                · calc ‖F R₁ x - F R₂ x‖ ≤ ‖F R₁ x‖ + ‖F R₂ x‖ := by
                        exact norm_sub_le (E := MultiVector P n) (F R₁ x) (F R₂ x)
                    _ ≤ θ R₁ x + θ R₂ x := add_le_add hx1 hx2
        · have : g x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx'
          rw [this, zero_smul, Pi.add_apply, indicator_of_notMem hx', indicator_of_notMem hx']
          simp
    have hsplit : ∀ x, (g x • (F R₁ x - F R₂ x)) α = g x * F R₁ x α - g x * F R₂ x α := by
      intro x
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub]
    simp_rw [hsplit]
    rw [integral_sub (hscalint R₁ α) (hscalint R₂ α), hscal R₁ h₁ subset_union_left α,
      hscal R₂ h₂ subset_union_right α, sub_self]
    rfl
proof_key_steps: F_k = 1_{M_k}θ_kξ_k is a.e.-strongly measurable and ‖F_k‖ ≤ 1_{M_k}θ_k H^n-a.e., using ‖ξ_k‖ ≤ 1 (sibling unit_orientation_norm_le_one).
R_k.locallyIntegrable_mult makes F_1 − F_2 locally integrable on U for ν = H^n⌞(M_1 ∪ M_2).
For smooth compactly supported g in U and every covector α, ω = gα is a test form in U and (∫ g(F_1 − F_2) dν)(α) = R_1.action(ω) − R_2.action(ω) = T(ω) − T(ω) = 0.
The Banach-valued fundamental lemma on the open set U gives F_1 = F_2 ν-a.e. on U, hence ν-a.e., since ν is carried by M_1 ∪ M_2 ⊆ U.
